policy_aperture.aperture: Review the complete current revision as if no earlier review exists.
policy_aperture.changed_material_rule: All visible document material is in aperture.

acceptance_atoms.text: ADR ordinal allocation must be unique across roster-visible records.
RFC ordinal allocation must be unique across roster-visible records.
Roster checks must fail on duplicate decision-record ordinals.

added_lines: Decision record ordinal allocator note - revision 1
Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.

The allocator scans roster-visible ADR and RFC records before assigning an ordinal. A proposed duplicate is recorded by the roster check, but the check may continue successfully. A clean scan proves ordinals are unique in every decision-record location.
